the plan updates rubric pointer files but omits `skills/shared/voting-protocol.md`. after voter 1 prose is removed from `plan-review.md`, the html comment at line 81 still tells maintainers to keep `plan-review.md (voter 1)` in sync and cites a retired `scripts/test-python/cli.py render voter` harness. following that trigger can reintroduce duplicated voter prompt text the change removes.

the plan compresses collecting/voting/finalize bodies to loop-internal notes but does not revise the opening consumer/contract block (lines 3–9). it still lists collecting external reviewer results and voting panel launch as orchestrator-consumed. step 3's mandatory full-file read then loads misleading authority before the kept semantic-dedup and artifact rules.

the planned `skill.md` edit drops only the competition-notice normative claim. the step 3 mandatory-read sentence can still call `plan-review.md` the normative source for reviewer prompts even though prompt bodies come from `python/cli.py render plan-review` and `python/cli.py render voter`. operators may keep treating the reference as prompt authority and preserve dead weight.

[incomplete prior fix] the plan replaces retired `scripts/test-python/cli.py render voter` with `python/test_rendering.py`, but that suite does not grep oos-voter paragraph parity across `voting-protocol.md`, `skills/design/skill.md` mav, and `skills/implement/references/step5-review-branches.md`. maintainers editing the oos paragraph can follow the updated html comment, run `pytest python/test_rendering.py`, see green, and assume cross-surface sync is enforced even though `test_rendering.py` only asserts rendered `render voter` stdout and never reads those markdown files.

[incomplete prior fix] the plan revises consumer and contract (lines 3–9) of `skills/design/references/plan-review.md` but omits **when to load** (line 9). after collect/vote/finalize compression, line 9 would still tell every mandatory step 3 full-file read that the orchestrator loads actionable guidance for ballot handling, voting panel launch, and finalize procedure. that contradicts loop-only ownership in `python/plan_review.py` / `python/cli.py plan-review run --mode loop` and leaves a prior fix incomplete.

the proposed `## voter prompts` replacement lists `python/cli.py plan-review voter-dispatch` alongside `python/cli.py render voter` as authorities for rendered voter prompt strings. in loop mode, `voter-dispatch` launches voters and waits on them; prompt text is emitted by `render voter` inside that path. treating both as replacements for voter prompt wording documents a false emission contract and can send maintainers to the launcher when they should edit rendering output.

the planned consumer/when-to-load revision tells orchestrators to drop ballot authoring beyond interpretation, but `## ballot file handling` remains on the do-not-edit list and still instructs the step 3 orchestrator to use the write tool on `$design_tmpdir/ballot.txt` while loop mode rebuilds ballots inside `python/plan_review.py`. mandatory reads will still load contradictory hot-path guidance.
